method: One pass over local metadata, 329 downloaded-video thumbnails, and existing temporal probes; no retrieval-score ranking.

dataset_summary.scope: All 345 exact user-supplied labels; first search page only; top 3 thumbnails and top 1 video requested per category, deduplicated globally.

selection_constraints: One representative per unique clip; aliases do not verify semantics.
Maximum two selected clips per source film.
All selected clips already have local video and thumbnail.
Existing intervals copied verbatim; new intervals null.
Retrieval scores are never semantic confidence.

inspection.scope: One archive thumbnail per unique downloaded video. One still cannot certify an entire clip.

known_category_rejections.605c7ded-bb70-57f6-ad07-e65268b0d7f6: Bear retrieval is a person and alphabet text/illustration card, not clean bear motion.
known_category_rejections.4ec8f534-f19b-5a1f-a2b8-3fbbf004839c: Kangaroo retrieval depicts deer in temporal probe samples; associated tiger/squirrel labels unverified.

limitations: 90 provisional clips have no selected intervals.
Rights statements copied, not independent rights clearance.
Still-key acceptance establishes neither motion quality nor training eligibility.
